Subject Implementation of CCPAP Module of Payment from 5" September,
2014.

Sir/Madam,

CCPAP Module in the above said offices may be rolled out from
05.09.2014.

2. The above offices may generate digitally signed CCPAP advice file and
upload the same to SBI SFTP server on 04.09.2014. The file of 04.09.2014 should
contain the details of cheques issued from A/c No. 1 & 10 on 04.09.2014 and also for
the period preceding three months prior to 04.09.2014. Thereafter, the file may be
uploaded on a daily basis in respect of cheques issued in A/c No. 1 & 10.

3. After uploading the file SBI will fetch the file available in designated
folder of SFTP server and perform further activities. Any technical issue for roll out
of CCPAP may be taken with Shri D.K. Pandey, AGM, SBI & Nodal Officer for
EPFO and Shri S. K. Panda, DD(IS).

4. The concerned officials may be in readiness for sending the details of
cheques issued during the preceding three months prior to 05.09.2014 and thereafter
on a daily basis. All RPFCs may ascertain that the digital signatures are functional.
A trial run may also be conducted by respective RPFCs before the scheduled date.

Yours faithfully,

A

(Sanjay Kumar)
Regional P.F. Commissioner-I(F&A)
